in_hebrew.name: Gabel
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gabel הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German word ‘gabal’, meaning ‘stranger’ or ‘traveler’. In the Middle Ages, Gabel was a common name for pilgrims and travelers who embarked on spiritual journeys.

in_greek.long_meaning: Gabel είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old German word ‘gabal’, meaning ‘stranger’ or ‘traveler’. In the Middle Ages, Gabel was a common name for pilgrims and travelers who embarked on spiritual journeys.
